messages.author: dc7349f8f4f4a135
messages.subject: issue with geom_area
parts:
Hi guys,

I'm having a trouble with geom_area and I have suspicion it is a bug.

I have attached the data file and plot output.

ggplot(actual_sub, 
       aes(
         x = processed_at_yearweek,
         y = total_amount,
         fill = transaction_state,
         group = transaction_state
       )
) + 
  geom_area() + 
  geom_line(aes(ymax=total_amount), position="stack")

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: issue with geom_area
parts:
It is indeed a bug...but not in ggplot. Your data frame has multiple y
values per x, such as:

X processed_at_yearweek transaction_state total_amount
15 15 201402 Successful 90.00
16 16 201402 Successful 96.10

So ggplot is trying to do what you asked, but things look goofy
because of this issue. You'll need to summarize your data (e.g.
summaring total_amount by processed_at_yearweek), eliminate
duplicates, or something similar before plotting.

Ben
